critical_governance: Every spatial product preserves CRS, datum, vertical datum/geoid and unit metadata.
Survey/reality-capture accuracy claims require QA evidence and authorized human acceptance.
Drone missions retain pilot, aircraft, payload, battery, flight and authorization evidence.
Regulatory/flight rules are configurable by jurisdiction and are not hard-coded as timeless assumptions.
AI may assist with feature recognition, change detection and anomaly review but may not certify survey accuracy or regulated flight authority.
Machine-control export packages require explicit validation and Phase 17 handoff controls.
